verdict.overall: Since Sunday the biggest mover is TSLA, up over 6%, but its near-term setup actually got weaker as gravity flipped to opposing and the floor dropped from 350 to 330; NVDA, PLTR and ZETA show the opposite pattern, each firming up with rising floors and friendlier near-term scores even on modest price moves. AVGO's range is quietly compressing lower while staying neutral, and several names (AMD, MU, AMAT, META) have no Sunday comparison but carry upcoming earnings or heavy option pricing that adds risk. Overall confidence in range-based setups is improving for NVDA, PLTR and ZETA, and fading for TSLA.
